model: Gateway Lunar Space Station, iHAB module (adapted extract)
credit: NASA/JSC/Gateway Program Office; Alberto G. Bertolin and Bradley W. Reynolds, Graphics and Animation Lab, Johnson Space Center

Acknowledge NASA as the source and do not imply NASA endorsement. NASA identifiers and insignia have separate protections; marked third-party material may require separate permission.
processing: Read the original GLB with glTF Transform SDK 4.5.1 NodeIO and retain the iHAB node subtree and its referenced meshes and materials.
Remove the I-Hab Radiator node and the six NDS Shutter and NDS Shutter hinge nodes; retain the docking rings and hatches.
Reset the parent mover rotation to identity and the iHAB node translation to zero for local placement; remove unreachable nodes and apply prune() before writing the GLB.
No remeshing or additional lossy compression was applied.

rebuild.note: Install the three dependencies outside the project and expose that node_modules directory through NODE_PATH. Rebuilding from the source above reproduced the shipped SHA-256 exactly.

context: The original depicts a planned lunar-orbit station. Its use as a surface habitat here is a fictional adaptation.
